channel.title: Art Ninja
channel.desc: Ricky lives in Bristol. By day he works as an animator- which is lucky because he loves art. He lives for art. He even dreams of art. He draws, he paints and - with his friends and members of his family who drop by - he makes ninja moves. That's why some people call him the Art Ninja. Ricky is inspired by extraterrestrials to make alien gloop. He also makes a Venus flytrap, and shows you how to do cut-out animation. Then he tries to cut it doing giant art with a lawn mower.
